articles.title: MAGA Melts Down at Grammy-Winning Superstar’s Onstage Plea
articles.description: Taylor Hill / Getty Images Country singer Kacey Musgraves has infuriated MAGA after asking her fans to help the children of “unfairly” deported immigrants during a live performance. The eight-time Grammy winner played the opening night of her new “Middle of Nowhere” tour at Chicago’s United Center on Friday, which was also her 38th birthday. During the show, the singer told the audience that her birthday wish was for fans to donate to the Young Center for Immigrant Children’s Rights, a Chicago-based nonprofit. Read more at The Daily Beast.
